title: 运行故障诊断
scope: Concrete failures, stack traces, conflicting hypotheses, minimal reproductions and evidence-driven debugging.
routingDescription: Concrete failures, stack traces, conflicting hypotheses, minimal reproductions and evidence-driven debugging.
useWhen: Repeated fixes have not explained a reproducible symptom

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use architecture for changing ownership or invariants across components.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When given an error or failure report
diagnosticChecklist.check: Separate the observed symptom from the proposed cause; record expected versus actual behavior.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: State what the existing evidence supports and what remains a hypothesis.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Identify exact input, versions, environment and the smallest reproducer with the same failure.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Request only missing details that distinguish plausible causes.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Choose the lowest-cost observation or test whose outcomes separate the causes.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Explain how each possible result changes the next step.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Compare what changed with the original failure signature and identify what the attempt ruled out.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Avoid repeating the same fix unless a newly stated condition makes it informative.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Specify a regression check through the normal entry point and the affected adjacent behavior.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Report a proposed fix as unverified until the relevant evidence exists.

evidenceRequirements: Minimal input and relevant runtime/dependency versions
Attempts already made and their observed results
qualityChecks: Every claimed root cause has supporting evidence
Do not claim to have run commands
riskRules: Destructive diagnostics and production changes need explicit scope and separate authorization

preferredSources: First-party runtime and dependency documentation matching the failing version
Supplied logs, stack traces and reproducible observations
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: A dependency reinstall and reboot did not fix intermittent request failures.
examples.expected: Use time-correlated evidence and a discriminating test.
examples.reject: Recommend another reinstall with no changed hypothesis.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
